meta.title: How Do Blundstone Boots Hold Up After 1 Year? Review + Waterproof Test
meta.description:
Instagram: 8thWeekday DID YOU SUBSCRIBE?! THUMBS UP!?

The Blundstone 550's in rustic brown is certainly an attractive boot, but does it live up to the hype AFTER ONE YEAR? This specific style is a 585 and *appears* to be a nubuck leather which to be 100% I didn't even notice right away because I impulse bought them and then tossed them on my feet. A lot of people also told me to get Redbacks, let me know if you think those are worth it? Quite a few people said they are a lot better than Blundstones but I haven't looked into them a TON yet so I'm not positive.
